title: Minimum Replacements to Balance Multi-Brackets
description:
You are given a string `s` consisting of four bracket kinds: `'('`, `')'`, `'['`, `']'`, `'{'`, `'}'`, `'<'`, and `'>'`.

In one replacement operation, you may replace any opening bracket (`'('`, `'['`, `'{'`, `'<'`) with any other opening bracket, OR replace any closing bracket (`')'`, `']'`, `'}'`, `'>'`) with any other closing bracket. You **cannot** turn an opening bracket into a closing bracket or vice versa.

Return the **minimum number of replacements** required to make `s` validly balanced, or `-1` if it is impossible.
hints: Because bracket directions (open vs close) can never change, the string can be balanced if and only if treating all opens as '(' and all closes as ')' forms a valid parentheses string.
Simulate a stack of opening brackets: on each closing bracket, pop the top opening bracket and add 1 to the cost whenever their bracket kinds do not match.

examples.explanation: '<' matches '>', '[' matches ')', and '{' matches '}'; only the '[' vs ')' pair mismatches, needing 1 replacement.
Every matched pair already has the same kind, needing 0 replacements.
An extra closing bracket occurs when the stack is empty, making balancing impossible (-1).
